oracleRisk.summary: CACEIS Fund Administration calculates the SAFO fund NAV, which determines subscriptions and redemptions. Chainlink publishes the exact USD SAFO NAV as NAVLink feed `SAFO NAV` through Ethereum proxy 0xC1E5FA6d48ba11cA163b03f2aBf843471eB7B2fB. At block 26243906 description() returned SAFO NAV, decimals() returned 6, aggregator() returned 0x3f2647A71cc99ff788a87160FEfB535F6Eb6896f, and latestRoundData answered 1024734 (1.024734 USD) updated at 2026-10-21T00:48:57Z. This establishes the external NAV publication path, without claiming independent valuation of CACEIS data, a second feed, or automatic failover. The documented heartbeat is 97200 seconds; the feed is not consumed by any reviewed SAFO liquidation path.
